fit.rule: AD.6: rules (i) fit pairs >= 100, (ii) best single direction accuracy >= 0.95 on the fit pairs = untestable at ceiling, (iii) fusion_frozen.json committed

estimand: Delta_B = Pr(Y_fus = 1) - Pr(Y_best = 1) on FOIL-COCO pairs, clean images, UniDisc
wording: the combination did not beat the better single score; minimum detectable net gain at the achieved n = 298 is 0.054 at an assumed discordance of 0.10 (0.066 at 0.15, 0.076 at 0.20, 0.037 at 0.05; power 0.8, exact two-sided McNemar, alpha' 0.05; discordance and split are assumed, not forecasts)

mde_at_achieved_n.note: minimum detectable net gain (b - c)/n for power 0.8, exact two-sided McNemar, favourable tail; pi_d (discordance) and theta (split) are ASSUMED, not forecasts (SAP A3.1)

sensitivity_first150_pool_positions.label: sensitivity (first 150 pool positions), not confirmatory, not in the Holm set

max_net_gain_note: 1 minus the better single accuracy on the test pairs; the attainable gain is smaller by the label-noise share (A3b.3 item 7)

stouffer_vs_best.label: descriptive, no p enters a claim

descriptive.note: the unfitted Stouffer statistic is reported first (spec 8) and is descriptive

label: family B, m = 1, alpha 0.05 (own family, no cross-family adjustment)
limits: not a corruption test: a within-modality gate cannot see a fluent foil word (derivation, E0, untested)

text-only cues (an a/an mismatch, a swap inside a compound noun, a duplicated word) can drive the text direction; no text-only baseline was run in this plan (adding one needs a dated addendum and is exploratory)

the negative mix differs between the fit pairs and the test pairs (ball to racket 11 of 300 test against 1 of 240 fit; a/an 15 of 300 against 7 of 240); the combination weights were fitted on the same negative type but not the same mix of negatives
(i) 26 of 300 test pairs (8.7 percent) are flagged by the COCO-instance rule (the foil's category is present in the image's COCO instances); this is a flag rate, not an error rate and not a bound
(ii) of those, 12 of 300 (4.0 percent; 5 plausibly true, 7 ambiguous) were judged questionable by one reader (thumbnails, E1), and the other 14 of the 26 were judged wrong by role
(iii) the rule fails to find the category of the original true noun in 26 of 300 test pairs (33 of 240 fit pairs); the rate of plausibly-true foils is not bounded by these data
no judgement exists for the 240 fit pairs beyond the rule's own count (18 of 240 flagged); the ceiling rule and the choice of the best direction are decided on those pairs

no pair is excluded, relabelled or reweighted for foil validity in the confirmatory analysis; the descriptive recomputation without the 26 flagged pairs is exploratory and no p-value of it enters a claim

label noise caps the attainable gain: the attainable net gain is at most 1 minus the better single accuracy minus the label-noise share, and the A3.1 power table does not include this cap; the sign of any bias on Delta_B is not established
all test images are in folds.json test/test_ext, so P and B are dependent in their data (separate families, separate alpha)
the COCO captions c+ are probably in UniDisc's training data (U8) and the text direction may be memorised; contamination of FOIL images (U8) is unmeasured
a rejection needs b > c_cnt; the label 'negative' is not available at these n
foil captions are lower-cased on both sides because of the case leak; the FOIL file revision (July 2017 vs Oct 2018) is unverified
